fields.Name: C1 -> S6.4
fields.Description: Gate G2.36 (phase 2, dataset C1, criterion S6.4): on C1 (the MoreCheese person-years) every region and tenure-band value of the holdout is its own slice, and every slice reports the primary score with a 95% interval on either side of it, 100% of slices. It fails when slice results drop their interval (fewer than 100% of slices).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Every C1 region and tenure-band slice reports log loss with a 95% interval (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
